prompts:
Create zealot-c.png, a production animation sprite sheet for Riley Wheel Brawl 2.0. Use the attached master-side.png as the LOCKED character design reference, matching face, conical helmet with short nasal guard, armor construction, cloth, muddy hems, palette, shield and sword geometry, outlines and shading exactly.
Canvas exactly 1536x1024 landscape with genuine transparent alpha background. Exactly EIGHT full-body drawings arranged TWO ROWS of FOUR, reading left-to-right then next row. Invisible cells 384x512; clear transparent gaps, no overlap or clipping. All same anatomical scale, fit each complete pose and weapons within its cell. Common ground baseline near y=480 for first row and y=992 for second row. Airborne frame floats above second baseline; lying frame lies on it. No visible grid, labels, text, numbers, floor, shadows, dust, effects or motion lines.
Character: adult broad male Whitecloak Zealot, stern clean-shaven square jaw, burnished conical steel helmet, visible eyes and face, long white wool cloak with brown mud at hem, white tabard over polished steel breastplate, gray mail sleeves, gold sunburst on left breast, brown belt and gloves, steel greaves and brown boots. LEFT arm carries large white wooden round shield with golden sunburst, steel rim and brass central boss. RIGHT hand straight steel arming sword with simple brass crossguard. Shield diameter and sword length and shape identical across all frames, including equipment lying beside him.
House style: hand-drawn HD 2D fighting game sprites in spirit of Streets of Rage 4, thick dark brown/near-black exterior ink contour and thinner interior outlines, clean 2-3 step cel shading with subtle painterly gradients, upper LEFT soft key light and gentle cool rim right, rich grounded colors, no pixel art, no 3D or photorealism, no chibi. Match reference faithfully.
Each cell is a genuinely new drawing and different pose, never copied or mirrored. Side/profile slight three-quarter view. Frames 1-6 face LEFT; 7-8 explicitly have HEAD ON RIGHT.
TOP ROW:
1: SHIELD CHARGE run stride 3. Running fiercely left, leaning far forward behind shield, dynamic long sprint stride unlike walk, shield forward left, sword back.
2: SHIELD SLAM. Shield driven hard LEFT at full arm extension, entire body braced behind it, forceful distinct lunge, sword held behind body.
3: SKID STOP. Facing left, heels dig in, legs stretched toward left, torso leans backward right to arrest charge, shield and sword retained.
4: DAZED. Facing left, staggering unsteadily after wall collision, helmet tilted on head, eyes unfocused, slack posture, sword hanging loosely, shield lowered.
BOTTOM ROW:
5: HURT FACE. Facing left, head snapped backward right by hit to face, chest recoiling, legs supporting stagger, no attacker or impact effect.
6: HURT GUT. Facing left, bent deeply double over abdomen, stagger backward right, distinct crouched folded torso, shield lowered and sword held loosely.
7: KNOCKED BACK. Launched toward RIGHT away from attacker left, entirely off feet and nearly horizontal ABOVE ground baseline. HEAD ON RIGHT, BOOTS ON LEFT. Back arches, limbs recoil, retain sword and shield. Leave clear air below body.
8: KNOCKED OUT. Lying flat on his back ON ground baseline, HEAD ON RIGHT, BOOTS ON LEFT, eyes closed, relaxed unconscious kid-friendly pose. Shield and sword lying beside him inside this cell. No blood, gore or injuries.
Ensure exactly two arms, two legs, two booted feet per character, correct hands, no extra limbs. Preserve full cloak and matching equipment in all eight. Real transparent background, not checkerboard artwork.

Edit this sprite sheet. Preserve the eight character drawings, their locked master design, equipment, poses and reading order. Critical correction: REMOVE ALL of the dark smoky background completely and replace it with GENUINE TRANSPARENT ALPHA. Every pixel outside the sprites must be alpha zero. No painted checkerboard, solid color, glow, floor or shadows. Output exactly 1536x1024 RGBA PNG. Arrange exactly four separate figures per row, two rows, with clear transparent gaps. Keep same character scale across all eight. Adjust spacing to fit each whole figure and weapon without overlap or clipping. Same baseline per row; knocked-back frame 7 stays airborne head RIGHT feet LEFT, frame 8 lies flat at baseline head RIGHT feet LEFT with shield and sword beside him. Frames 1-6 face left. Do not change art style, face, conical helmet, armor, muddy white cloth, sunbursts, sword shape or shield shape. All eight poses must stay distinct. Transparent cutout sprite sheet, not a scene.
note: Eight figures inspected in two rows of four; requested order and head-right airborne and knocked-out poses present. Real alpha verified with PIL; original generated pixels preserved.
